pinned.name: Time_Warp_Studio
pinned.description: Time Warp Studio is a unified desktop programming environment designed for educators and students. It brings together 24 programming languages spanning seven decades of computing history into a single, modern IDE. Built with Python and PySide6 (Qt6), it provides an integrated platform for learning programming concepts, exploring vector turtle graph

pinned.name: GulfOfMexico
pinned.description: Esoteric programming language interpreter — -1-based indexing, three-valued booleans, tiered & tilde equality, temporal lifetimes, compound assignment, emoji identifiers, negative hoisting, and a 5-theme GUI IDE. 170 tests, 26 demos. Based on Lu Wilson's (TodePond) DreamBerd spec.

pinned.name: Mellivora_OS
pinned.description: Mellivora OS is a from-scratch hobby OS that boots on real x86 hardware or in QEMU. It includes a custom HBFS filesystem, ring 3 user-mode execution, a DOS-inspired interactive shell with POSIX features, 82 syscalls, priority-based preemptive scheduling, signal support, an in-OS Tiny C Compiler

pinned.name: LifeGrid
pinned.description: A feature-rich cellular automata simulator with a modern Tkinter GUI, headless CLI, REST/WebSocket API, GPU acceleration, and plugin support.

pinned.name: Pebble_Pal
pinned.description: 🪨 Virtual pet stone companion — feed, play, customize & level up your rock! Desktop (Electron) + iOS/Android (Capacitor). Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS.

pinned.name: Lake_Ontario
pinned.description: Lake Ontario BASIC is a whimsical, and satirical programming language built in the spirit of classic BASIC — infused with politeness, progressive values, and a fearless Honey Badger attitude that takes zero shit from MAGA spin, GOP propaganda, or oligarch intimidation.  In Lake Ontario, alternative facts don't compile, universal healthcare protects
